Bash(git -C "d:\MailAgent" commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Fix email selection bug preventing bulk operations

CRITICAL FIX: The threadId extraction logic had a copy-paste error that prevented
email checkboxes from working correctly, breaking all bulk operations.

Bug:
```typescript
const threadId = (''threadId'' in thread ? thread.threadId : thread.threadId) || '''';
//                                                           ^^^^^^^^^^^^
//                                                           Same on both sides!
```

Fix:
```typescript
const threadId = thread.threadId || (''id'' in thread ? thread.id : '''') || '''';
```

Impact:
- Email selection checkboxes now work correctly
- Bulk delete, bulk mark read/unread, bulk star, etc. all work
- Sync-back operations now receive correct email IDs to sync to providers

Before: Selecting emails did nothing, bulk delete sent 0 emails
After: Selection works, bulk operations sync correctly to Gmail/Microsoft

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
